SELECT
    RAWTOHEX(r.REQUEST_ID) AS REQUEST_ID,
    r.CONTRACT_SERIAL,

    r.REQUEST_TYPE_ID,
    rt.REQUEST_TYPE_CODE,
    rt.REQUEST_TYPE_NAME,

    r.REQUEST_DATE,

    RAWTOHEX(r.STATUS_ID) AS STATUS_ID,
    rs.STATUS_CODE,
    rs.STATUS_NAME,
    rs.FLOW_STATUS_STEP_NO,

    RAWTOHEX(t.TERMINAL_ID) AS TERMINAL_ID,

    t.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID,
    tt.TERMINAL_TYPE_DESC,

    t.STATUS AS TERMINAL_STATUS,
    t.ACTIVATE_DATE,
    t.OLD_TID_REPLACED,

    m.CIF,
    RAWTOHEX(m.MERCHANT_ID) AS MERCHANT_ID

FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST r

JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_TYPE rt
    ON rt.REQUEST_TYPE_ID = r.REQUEST_TYPE_ID

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_STATUS rs
    ON rs.STATUS_ID = r.STATUS_ID

JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT m
    ON m.MERCHANT_ID = r.MERCHANT_ID
    AND NVL(m.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL t
    ON t.REQUEST_ID = r.REQUEST_ID
    AND NVL(t.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL_TYPE tt
    ON tt.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID = t.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID
    AND NVL(tt.ACTIVE_FLAG, 1) = 1

WHERE r.MERCHANT_ID =
    HEXTORAW(
        REPLACE(
            '{{ JS_Merchant_Workplace.getMerchantId() }}',
            '-',
            ''
        )
    )

AND NVL(r.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0

AND r.REQUEST_TYPE_ID <> 1

ORDER BY
    r.CREATED_AT DESC,
    t.CREATED_AT DESC
